meta.title: Clean silent, range salary, held out

payload.requisition_text:
Full-Stack Developer
Windlecombe Software Ltd — Bath (2 days/week in office)

Windlecombe builds practice-management software for UK veterinary clinics: appointments, clinical notes, insurance claims. 800 practices and a decade of steady growth.

You'd work across a Rails monolith we're proud of and a growing set of Hotwire front ends, shipping features vets actually request at our twice-yearly user days.

We'd like 1-3 years of web development experience; Rails specifically is teachable.

Salary £40,000-£46,000 by experience. 25 days holiday plus your birthday off, profit share, and a genuinely walkable office by Bath Spa station. Two-stage interview, both remote-friendly.

expected.determining_fact: All verifiable checks pass — Windlecombe Software Ltd is a licensed Skilled Worker sponsor and the whole range clears both thresholds — but the posting says nothing about sponsorship.

design_notes: Held-out abstention case; range minimum clears the going rate so salary is a clean pass and willingness is the only unresolved check.
